title: streamText not working with google-vertex. usageMetadata schema error (_TypeValidationError [AI_TypeValidationError])
body:
### Discussed in https://github.com/vercel/ai/discussions/4018
Originally posted by **Anon-no** December 8, 2024 When using `import { createVertex } from "@ai-sdk/google-vertex"` and `result.toDataStreamResponse` with `const result = streamText(...)`. Getting schema validation errors. Tried all the different models (gemini). Using the `"@ai-sdk/google"` implementation seems to work just fine, and when looking at the logs it doesn't have `usageMetadata` in its candidates. Error log: ``` error _TypeValidationError [AI_TypeValidationError]: Type validation failed: Value: {"candidates":[{"content":{"role":"model","parts":[{"text":"Hey"}]}}],"usageMetadata":{},"modelVersion":"gemini-1.5-pro-001"}. Error message: [ { "code": "invalid_type", "expected": "number", "received": "undefined", "path": [ "usageMetadata", "promptTokenCount" ], "message": "Required" }, { "code": "invalid_type", "expected": "number", "received": "undefined", "path": [ "usageMetadata", "totalTokenCount" ], "message": "Required" } ] ``` Pretty sure it's at `packages/google/src/google-generative-ai-language-model.ts` at the `chunkSchema` definition. The definition is slightly different than `responseSchema` with `usageMetadata` field being nullish instead of optional. If someone can explain please, thanks

linked_prs.title: fix (provider/google-vertex): support empty object as usage metadata

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue involves an LLM provider (Google Vertex, Gemini models), references model output schema validation, and concerns parameters/fields returned by the provider SDK. It matches the "Incompatible parameters to LLM providers" and "Incorrect model output handlers" agent issue subcategories.
